::: {#rem-monte-carlo-se-estimate}
#### Reporting a Monte Carlo standard error

The [standard deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-sd) $\SD{T}$ in @thm-monte-carlo-se is unknown,
so a study reports the [sample standard deviation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-sd) $s_T$ of the [estimates](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $T_1, \ldots, T_M$
divided by $\sqrt{M}$ in its place.
That [Monte Carlo standard error](#def-monte-carlo-standard-error) shrinks like $1 / \sqrt{M}$,
so quadrupling the number of [replications](#def-replication) halves it.
A [simulation estimate](#def-simulation-estimate) should be reported with its Monte Carlo standard error,
so a reader can tell a real difference from random variation in the simulation.
:::
